howto: Tap the left or right half of the road (or press Left / Right) to change lane.
Do not hit the cars coming down the road.
Your fuel (top right) drops every second; drive over green + cans for 5 more seconds.
Drive 1000 m before the tank runs dry.
tips: Fuel cans come every couple of seconds in a random lane: they are worth a small risk.
Traffic speeds up the further you drive.
The middle lane lets you dodge either way.
Easy starts with a fuller tank and slower traffic.

controls.keyboard: Left / Right arrows (or A / D) change lane; Space starts. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap the left or right half of the road. Pause button top left.

difficulty: Easy: 30 s of fuel and slow, spaced-out traffic. Normal: 22 s. Hard: 16 s and fast, dense traffic.

cheats.effect: Other cars and fuel cans move at half speed
Knock cars out of the way instead of crashing

features.one-tap-start: Tap, Space or an arrow key on the title card
features.instant-restart: Tap once on the CRASHED! / OUT OF FUEL! / SAFE TRIP! card
features.best-score-badge: BEST metres under the distance counter
features.tutorial-card: First-run How to play card with an animated swipe; replay from Pause > How to play
features.results: CRASHED! / OUT OF FUEL! card with metres and best, or SAFE TRIP!
